title: Entitlement
description: Assignment grant evaluated on every endpoint, queued job, download and spatial request (technical specification 'Assignment' row; allow_public_read OR allow_protected). Scoped object membership is resolved server-side; a body actorId or browser role switch never grants anything. Deputies act only through an explicit, time-bounded delegation - never automatically statewide. Concurrent revocation invalidates entitlement caches; the authoritative assignment version is rechecked on each protected request.

principalId.description: Person or organization holding the grant.

role.description: Role family. Engineer sub-profiles (field, regional, automation, modeler) are capability subsets, not extra authority.

capabilities.description: Action-specific granted capabilities, e.g. enter-readings, revise-best-available, edit-site-metadata, create-sites, withdraw-raw.

scopeType.description: Kind of object the grant is scoped to.

scopeId.description: Scoped object identifier; null only for statewide scope.

effectiveAt.description: UTC instant the grant becomes valid.

expiresAt.description: UTC instant the grant lapses; null means no scheduled expiry.

status.description: Authoritative status; revoked wins over any cached copy.

delegation.description: Present only for deputy grants: an explicit delegation with effective and expiry dates.

grantVersion.description: Monotonic assignment version; protected requests compare against this to refuse stale caches.
